csv_project_name: AE for UNI Central Campus Chilled Water Study
csv_scope_of_work: The University of Northern Iowa (UNI) is seeking qualification statements from design firms to provide planning services associated with a chilled water study on the UNI's Central Campus in Cedar Falls, IA. It is anticipated the study will focus on the following objectives. Assessment of steam absorption chillers as a viable product including quantities of existing chillers in the US (regionally) and in other countries. Assessment of qualified steam absorption service technicians in the US as well as parts availability. Assessment of the future of steam absorption chiller technology and systems the university can use for future chilled water system equipment replacements. Evaluate alternative options to produce and deliver chilled water to campus buildings. Evaluate each system economically (life cycle) including how they will affect the operation and economics of the power plant.
csv_disciplines_requested: Rehabilitation & Refurbishment, Civil Engineering, Feasibility Studies, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Hydrology/Hydraulics

title: AE for UNI Central Campus Chilled Water Study
short_description: Planning study for chilled water system options and steam absorption chiller assessment.
project_scope: Planning study for the University of Northern Iowa Central Campus chilled water system. The study is to assess steam absorption chillers as a viable technology, including existing chiller quantities in the US and internationally, availability of qualified service technicians and spare parts, and the future of steam absorption chiller technology for replacement planning. It must also evaluate alternative options to produce and distribute chilled water to campus buildings and compare systems economically on a life-cycle basis, including impacts on power plant operation and economics.
services: Planning services / study services; feasibility assessment; rehabilitation and refurbishment-related consulting; civil, electrical, mechanical, and hydrology/hydraulics input.
relevance_explanation:
- This is primarily a chilled water and utility systems study, not a structural or bridge project.
- Focus is on mechanical/electrical plant assessment and feasibility, which is outside sbp's core profile.
- No building structure, long-span roof, bridge, stadium, or special structural engineering component is described.
- The tender matches excluded areas such as MEP/building services and feasibility studies.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction budget is stated. The notice describes only a planning/feasibility study for chilled water production and distribution options; no defined construction scope, capacities, or quantities are provided that would support a realistic construction cost estimate.
fee_explanation: No fee information is stated in the notice.
references_qualifications: Design firms are requested to submit qualifications for planning services. Disciplines requested include rehabilitation and refurbishment, civil engineering, feasibility studies, electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, and hydrology/hydraulics. No specific minimum reference counts or detailed qualification thresholds are stated in the provided text.
award_criteria: One contractor will be selected; detailed award criteria and weighting are not stated in the provided text.
